summary: Tested new Profit & Loss dashboard feature (backend + frontend). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Only pnl-net-kpi has a data-testid; the other 3 KPI cards (Quoted revenue, Purchases, Monthly overhead) have no testids. Not blocking, but adding data-testid (pnl-revenue-kpi, pnl-purchases-kpi, pnl-overhead-kpi) would improve test robustness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profit & Loss dashboard verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/finance/profit-dashboard requires admin (403 for reseller). Frontend renders KPIs, ComposedChart, and monthly table; range selector (SELECT element) switches 6<->12 months and updates table rows. Admin gating enforced at both route level (redirects reseller to /) and nav visibility (nav-profit-dashboard hidden for reseller). Current month (Jul 26) shows $2,616.11 revenue from 8 quotes, net -$22,021.83 in red as expected.

verified_behavior.chart_renders_with_legend: Net profit, Quoted revenue, Total cost
